description: Lean multi-agent delivery orchestrator combining OpenBoard (task DAG and source of truth) with Armada sandboxes (parallel worker fleet).
notes:
## Captain

Lean, zero-Python multi-agent delivery orchestrator for OpenBoard + Armada across five modes (`init`, `plan`, `run`, `resume`, `challenge`). Uses OpenBoard, Armada, and GitHub directly as the live source of truth — zero shadow databases.

### Prerequisites
- **OpenBoard CLI (`ob`)** connected to a board reachable from your Armada sandboxes (HTTPS for remote Modal sandboxes; local SQLite only with local Docker hosts).
- **Armada CLI (`>= 14.x`, or `npx -y @the-vibe-company/armada@latest`)** authenticated with an org, GitHub connection, provider, and model credentials.
- **GitHub CLI (`gh`)** authenticated for GitHub pull request supervision.

### Modes
- **`init`**: CLI preflight (including MCP `defaultForLaunch` / `needs_reconnect` check), monorepo/solo/team + harness readiness inspection, adopts existing review workflows (or offers `ship-pr-dev`), sets up OpenBoard (`AGENTS.md`, channel), provisions Modal OpenBoard auth via Armada Vault (`variables/set`, `secrets/set`) + Launch Templates (`armada template launch`) with harness smoke test, and writes minimal `.captain/config.json`.
- **`plan`**: delegated discovery, `grilling`, atomic OpenBoard `plan.json` DAG (JSON object `labels`, `needs`, DB migration serialization, anti-slop & observable verification).
- **`run`**: live Armada `>= 14.x` Launch Template / `--no-connections` workers, single or round-robin Builder + optional Scout/Light with auto-escalation, hard circuit breakers, `MAIN_RED` freeze, zero-Python `armada-modal.sh` + `watchdog.sh` (or native host timer).
- **`challenge`**: objective git/gh/ob metrics dossier + independent read-only Challenger every 10/20 PRs with progressive authority (`ON_TRACK` / `DRIFTING` / `OFF_THE_RAILS`) and `.captain/rules.md` STOP rules.
- **`resume`**: live OpenBoard/Armada/GitHub reconciliation (including orphan sandboxes) and secret-free `.captain/HANDOFF.md`.

changes: Fixed Modal OpenBoard authentication: documented and wired Armada 14.x Vault (`secrets/set` via stdin + `variables/set`) + Launch Templates (`armada template launch`) with native `ob connect "$BOARD_URL" --as <profile>` reading `OPENBOARD_SECRET` from harness env and one-turn harness smoke test (replacing Docker-only `--secret`/`--variable` assumptions).

Added zero-Python `scripts/armada-modal.sh` helper (`preflight-mcp`, `wait-build`, `wait-ready`, `launch-template`, `launch-raw`) absorbing real Modal CLI traps: `needs_reconnect` defaultForLaunch MCP 409 conflicts (`--no-connections` / `connections: []`), `snapshot new --wait` returning during `phase: secret_scan`, `snapshot show --build` refusing `--org`, and `armada exec` `not_found` while `status: starting`.
Updated `evals/evals.json` to match the zero-Python Captain architecture and Modal Launch Template flow.
Slimmed architecture to zero-Python: removed heavy local state-mirroring scripts and kept a single hardened POSIX bash watchdog (`scripts/watchdog.sh`).
Extracted multi-angle exploration into standalone `deep-dive` skill for clean MECE boundaries.

Fixed real OpenBoard 0.9 (`ob tasks counts`, JSON object `labels`, worker-owned `ob tasks block`) and Armada 14.8 (`--org`, `--`, version >= 14, sandbox OpenBoard auth, root+user `ob` install) compatibility.

Added hard circuit breakers, `MAIN_RED` freeze, DB migration exclusive serialization, anti-slop worker briefs, objective Challenger metrics, and Skillpack dependencies on `grilling` and `ship-pr-dev`.
